item.title: Chicago man has been sentenced for his role in a smuggling operation into FCI McDowell
item.description: McDowell, WV (WOAY) – A Chicago man has been sentenced for his role in a smuggling operation into FCI McDowell. Auturo Joel Gallegos was sentenced to three years of federal probation. Gallegos admitted to his role in flying packages of cell phones, tobacco, and marijuana into FCI McDowell.
